exposure: All four images were seen in E54 and E57 and again before this protocol; selected chant identities and capture ordering are known. This is an unblinded follow-up, not preregistration or independent reading.

rules: Identical ink or damage must be visibly matched before asserting image overlap; textual succession alone is not physical overlap.
